title: Calm mumbling crowd with horse drawn carriage hooves and bells by imagefilm.berlin
author: imagefilm.berlin
sourceDescription: This ambient field recording captures the lively atmosphere of a wide-open field with a crowd of people softly mumbling, the distinct sounds of horse-drawn carriages waiting, occasional bell whistles, and the rhythmic clapping of hooves. The recording offers a rich texture of natural and human activity, ideal for scenes that require an outdoor, bustling yet organic ambiance.
